nodes.name: When called by the Orchestrator
nodes.notes: Inputs: stage "00".."07", month "YYYY-MM", args (string or array of tokens), label for notifications.

nodes.name: Build command
nodes.notes: Validates the inputs and shell-quotes every token. The only place a value reaches a shell.

nodes.name: Run stage
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData + continueRegularOutput so a non-zero exit still produces an item to classify. NOTE (measured, n8n 2.35.7): these settings keep the workflow running but do NOT restore exitCode or stdout, which this node drops on any non-zero exit. The __EXIT__ sentinel added by Build command is what actually carries the exit code — an exit 10 must not fail this node, and must not be mistaken for an exit 1.

nodes.name: Classify
nodes.notes: The single copy of the contract. Returns {ok, stage, month, label, exitCode, outcome, json, contractViolation, stderrTail, durationMs}.
